title: Footprints
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, isolated log cabin on a snowy mountain during a blizzard, cold blue moonlight against warm firelight, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. The footprints came to the door. None of them left. ❄️

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: The snow had been falling for nine hours when Nora Lind saw the footprints.
scenes.image: a woman in a thick sweater staring out a frosted cabin window at deep snow, night

scenes.narration: She and her brother Caleb had driven up to clear out their father's cabin. Three weeks after the funeral. One last weekend. Then the storm closed the road behind them.
scenes.image: small log cabin half buried in snow on a mountain slope, one warm lit window, heavy blizzard

scenes.narration: The prints came out of the treeline. Bare feet. Long and narrow. Spaced too far apart for anyone walking.
scenes.image: a line of long narrow bare footprints in fresh snow leading out of dark pine trees under moonlight

scenes.narration: They crossed the yard in a perfectly straight line. Up the porch steps. Right to the front door.
scenes.image: bare footprints climbing snow-covered wooden porch steps to a closed cabin door, lantern glow

scenes.narration: Caleb said it was a lost hiker. Freezing, maybe hurt. He grabbed a flashlight and threw the door open. Nobody was there.
scenes.image: bearded man in a flannel coat holding a flashlight in an open cabin doorway, snow blowing in

scenes.narration: Nora walked the whole porch. She checked underneath it. She checked every window. The snow was smooth everywhere else. Not one print led away.
scenes.image: woman holding a lantern on a snowy cabin porch, smooth untouched snow beyond the railing

scenes.narration: Whatever walked up to that door never walked back down.
scenes.image: close-up of a single bare footprint pressed into snow at the threshold of a wooden door

scenes.narration: Caleb said the wind had filled them in. But the wind hadn't touched the ones coming in.
scenes.image: man forcing a nervous laugh beside a stone fireplace, a woman behind him staring at the door

scenes.narration: They bolted the door and shoved the couch against it. Around midnight, Nora noticed the cabin smelled like pine and cold air. Like a door had been left open. Every door was shut.
scenes.image: dark cabin hallway at night, frost creeping across the inside of a closed wooden door

scenes.narration: Then, in the attic above her bed, something took one long, slow step.
scenes.image: a wooden attic hatch in a cabin ceiling, frost spreading around its edges, darkness above
